_about: A model of one copy activity in a pipeline. source and destination.existing_columns are facts about the files and the table; change the settings around them. table_option is "Use existing" or "Auto create table". mapping lists {source, destination} column pairs (empty means the default mapping). Under settings, staging location is "Workspace" or "External"; an External location names a connection. pre_copy_script is null or one of destination.script_choices, copied exactly.
needs: Each night's files land in the existing Warehouse table dbo.sales_landing, whose column names the reports already use.
The landing table holds only the latest night's rows; downstream jobs read all of it.
Month-end runs take about 90 minutes. The team has an ADLS Gen2 connection, adls-staging, for interim data.
The upstream cleanup sometimes deletes a store's file while the copy runs. That shouldn't fail the night, but someone must be able to see which files were skipped.
A file the pipeline isn't allowed to read means a permissions mistake, and the run should fail.

source._note: Each file starts with a two-line banner before its header row.

script_choices: DELETE FROM dbo.sales_landing WHERE SoldAt < DATEADD(day, -30, CAST(GETDATE() AS date))
